description: The account's shared Renovate preset: one run a month, minor and patch updates in one pull request, majors only after approval, action pins as SHAs, a monthly lock file refresh, every version at least seven days old, no automerge.

packageRules.description: A major is a migration, not an update: its pull request opens only once it is approved on the Dependency Dashboard, and it is verified on its own.
Minor, patch and action SHA updates in one pull request: each pull request costs a CI run, and several on the same lockfile conflict with one another.
